camel_example: aliyun cms PutCustomMetricRule --region cn-hangzhou --MetricName cpu_total --ContactGroups ECS_Group --ComparisonOperator '=' --RuleId MyRuleId1 --EvaluationCount 3 --Level CRITICAL --Resources 'groupId_:73780000,_dimension_:_instanceId=i-hp3543t5e4sudb3s0000' --Statistics Average --Threshold 90
description_en: Creates an alert rule for custom monitoring
description_zh: 调用PutCustomMetricRule接口创建自定义监控报警规则
kebab_example: aliyun cms put-custom-metric-rule --rule-id MyRuleId1 --metric-name cpu_total --resources groupId_:73780000,_dimension_:_instanceId=i-hp3543t5e4sudb3s0000 --contact-groups ECS_Group --threshold 90 --level CRITICAL --evaluation-count 3 --statistics Average --comparison-operator = --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutCustomMetricRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application group to which the custom monitoring data belongs.

A value of 0 indicates that the reported custom monitoring data does not belong to any application group
parameters.help_zh:
自定义监控数据所属应用分组ID。

0表示上报的自定义监控数据不属于任何一个应用分组
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert rule.

If the alert rule ID already exists, the alert rule is modified. If the alert rule ID does not exist, an alert rule is created
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则ID。

如果报警规则ID已存在，则表示修改报警规则；如果报警规则ID不存在，则表示创建报警规则
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metric.

For information about how to obtain the metric name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115005.html
parameters.help_zh:
监控项名称。

获取方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115005.html
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The custom monitoring data to which the alert rule applies. The value consists of the application group ID to which the custom monitoring data belongs and the dimensions of the metric
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则作用的自定义监控数据。由自定义监控数据所属应用分组ID和监控项所属维度组成
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en: The alert contact group. Separate multiple alert contact groups with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 报警联系人组。多个联系人组之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: contact_groups

parameters.help_en: The webhook URL that is called when an alert is triggered. A POST request is sent to this URL
parameters.help_zh: 报警发生回调时指定的URL地址，向URL发送POST请求
parameters.name: webhook

parameters.help_en: The time range during which the alert rule is effective. Valid values: 00:00-23:59
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则生效的时间范围。取值范围：00:00-23:59
parameters.name: effective_interval

parameters.help_en:
The mute for period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day).

If monitoring data continuously exceeds the alert rule threshold, only one alert notification is sent within each mute for period
parameters.help_zh:
通道沉默周期。单位：秒，默认值：86400（1天）。

当监控数据持续超过报警规则阈值时，每个沉默周期内只发送一次报警通知
parameters.name: silence_time

parameters.help_en: The aggregation period of the custom monitoring data. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60 or a multiple of 60. Default value: the original reporting period of the custom monitoring data
parameters.help_zh: 自定义监控数据的聚合周期。单位：秒。取值为60或60的整数倍。默认为自定义监控数据的原始上报周期
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The subject of the alert email
parameters.name: email_subject

parameters.help_en:
The severity level of the alert. Valid values:
CRITICAL: critical.
WARN: warning.
INFO: information
parameters.help_zh:
报警级别。取值：
CRITICAL：严重。
WARN：警告。
INFO：信息
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The number of retries for the alert
parameters.name: evaluation_count

parameters.help_en: The statistical method for the alert
parameters.name: statistics

parameters.help_en:
The comparison operator for the threshold. Valid values:

`>=`

`=`

`<=`

`>`

`<`

`!=`
parameters.name: comparison_operator

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the call is successful, this parameter is empty. If the call fails, the error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息。接口调用成功时，返回为空；接口调用失败时，返回失败原因
Message.example: ComparisonOperator is mandatory for this action.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: successful.

false: failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
